notes.title: Hotfix 2.1 is LIVE | Save-related Issues
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Loves 🫶[/p][p][/p][h3]Hotfix 2.1[/h3][p]Hotfix 2.1 is LIVE on PC![/p][p]This patch addresses critical save-related issues surfaced with Hotfix 2. Saves are handled differently across various platforms, manifesting the issue in several ways. On steam, this tends to leave players stuck on the loading screen. [/p][p]This issue should now be resolved ✅[/p][p][/p][h3]SPECS[/h3][p]In addition, we have aimed to get to the bottom of SPECS discrepancies and have worked hard to get this complex system right. As an effect players might see changes in their score, but that has been done to more accurately capture the intended state. [/p][p]If SPECS are lost from New Game+, we recommend reloading a save from right before this patch, initiating the epilogue, and starting again from there. We apologize for the inconvenience.[/p][p][/p][h3]What's Next?[/h3][p]We’re hard at work addressing several bugs and issues you’ve been reporting, and we’ll share more news on the next Hotfix as soon as possible. [/p][p]And thank you all for your continued patience and invaluable help![/p][p][/p][h3]Find Love with the Lavish Edition -10% OFF[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/sub/1323524/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

[h3]❗Update [/h3]

[quote]Hello Loves,

We’re working on addressing new issues that surfaced with Hotifx 2 as a priority – including, but not limited to: 

SPECS points - Rebalanced for some players as certain Dateables were granting the wrong SPECS type. This has inadvertently caused new blockers, preventing realisation.
Lyric - Stuck in repeated dialogue loop 
Scandalabra - Stuck in ‘unfinished business’ loop
Dasha - Unable to realise 
Rebel - Stuck in a loop
Celia - Stuck in a loop

We are aiming to remedy these issues with Hotfix 3. Thank you for taking the time to report these problems! We’ll update you as soon as we have more info on Hotfix 3.[/quote]

notes.title: Date Everything! Hotfix Patch 1 - Out Now on Steam!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello loves,

[b]We've just released our first Hotfix Patch for Date Everything! on Steam! [/b]

Before we get into the patch details, we want to thank you for all your support since our sandbox dating-sim launched earlier in the week. 🫶

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120785/9429c000f14a24499236868d77d4bac61c179c47.png[/img][/p]

Hotfix Patch 1 for Steam brings fixes to community-reported bugs, including [b]a fix to the Date-a-dex scrolling[/b] sound effect issue, [b]fixes to blocks for the Hate Everything[/b] Achievement and [b]✨ more! ✨[/b]

We hope you enjoy Hotfix Patch 1 and have an even smoother experience with our 100+ dateables in Date Everything! 💞

[h2]⚙️ Hotfix Patch 1 - Patch Notes[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed an issue with the Date-a-dex, where the scrolling sound effect would persist on the Date-a-dex menu screen.
[*] Fixed blocking issues, affecting the Hate Everything Achievement. Fixes below contain achievement spoilers, which have been [spoiler]spoiler tagged[/spoiler]. These fixes include:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Abel's Hate ending, [spoiler]where players were unable to obtain this if they had already experienced the Hate ending with Dasha.[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed an issue with obtaining Jerry's Hate ending, which causes Cam to break.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Hero Hime, [spoiler]where players were unable to unlock the Hero Hime when following the the 100 Hate Endings path.[/spoiler][/list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some players was unable to obtain friendship status with Timothy.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Scandalabra, [spoiler]where the candle kiss animation failed for some players.[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed an issue with Jerry's carousel, which did not appear for every ending.
[*] Fixed an issue with Chairemi, where the unique friendship pose for Chairemi was missing.
[*] Fixed a font issue where incorrect letters would appear in one of Dasha's text dialogue lines.
[*] Fixed various VO-text mismatches and typos. [/list]
[h3]Player Support[/h3]
If you run into any issues with Date Everything! please reach out to our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2201320/discussions/1/]Support Team via the Report a Problem forum.[/url]

[h2]Our next Hotfix patch[/h2]
We are currently working on Hotfix 2, which addresses a WHOLE HOST of issues that came up once 150,000+ of you all started playing at once. Hotfix 2 will fix hundreds of bugs, most especially the blockers with characters like Arma, Beverly, Scandalabra, Gaia, Rebel, Maggie, and more.

Thanks for your patience and for reporting all of these in detail, so that we can squash more bugs you've reported and make our sandbox dating-sim the most pristine experience for you!

[h2]Steam Stats 👀[/h2]
Connie is thrilled to share our Date Everything! Steam launch stats with you...

[b]🗽 #5 in America
🌍 #10 Worldwide[/b]

We've been blown away by your incredible support - this is all thanks to you! 🥹

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120785/f9bb1d07b4c8efdcd35cc1a0593edac472d0e5b9.png[/img]

That's all for now loves... but we'll see you very soon with more Date Everything! news 🫶

notes.title: Date Everything, the dating sim where your whole house becomes dateable, finally has a release date
notes.notes: Dating sim Date Everything, the game where you can literally date everything, has finally received a release date after it was delayed at the start of this year. Officially slated for a June 17 launch, it's finally time to mark our calendars for the release of what could become one of the best, most obscure, dating simulators of all time... Read more.
